a1_boundary_design.failed_gate: novelty=1/3<0.5; future return to baseline is irrelevant
novelty=7/18<0.5; sustained expansion may instead become target 1 if all gates pass
growth<1.5, new_distinct<4 and novelty<0.5; event count alone is insufficient
novelty=0.4<0.5; changing one old wallet to a baseline-new wallet reaches0.5

a1_positive_diversity: Gradual acquisition: D12, baseline median8, U6 illustrates equality at growth1.5 and novelty0.5.
Sharp acquisition: D12, baseline median5, U8 illustrates stronger growth and novelty.
Moderate growth with novelty: D8, baseline median5, U5 illustrates ratio1.6 and novelty0.625.
Sustained acquisition after a stable baseline: D18, median10, U10 illustrates growth1.8 and novelty0.556.
boundary_coverage: For every numeric gate, future hand fixtures include exact equality, one integer step either side where possible, and plausible count/amount perturbations. Population recipes vary one or several components, never expose distance-to-full-predicate as an input.

categories.mechanism: High counts with one dominant payment, or activity concentrated in fewer than 3 hour buckets, or established comparable daily baseline.
categories.name: Busy wallet / same-day activity
categories.required_failed_family_condition: S1 max share>0.60 or acceleration<3; S3 occupied hours<3 or day growth<2.

categories.mechanism: Similar amounts across prior and recent periods; or mixed current payments diluting the similar cluster.
categories.name: Recurring payments
categories.required_failed_family_condition: S2 cluster share<0.60 or cluster growth<2; do not lower label because recurring origin is legitimate.

categories.mechanism: Large repeated transfers on a stable schedule; high-value band occurs in all origins.
categories.name: Recurring legitimate large payments
categories.required_failed_family_condition: S4 band share<0.40, fewer than 3 recent band events, or band growth<2; exact-same band values also fail required variation.

categories.mechanism: Several payers with stable prior incoming volume, or many recent transfers from only 2 payers.
categories.name: Legitimate collection
categories.required_failed_family_condition: N1 incoming growth<2 or distinct senders<3.

categories.mechanism: Recurring dispersion with strong prior baseline; alternatively outward transfers use only a small fraction of recent funding.
categories.name: Payroll / transit-like dispersion
categories.required_failed_family_condition: N2 outgoing growth<2; N4 O/F<0.5 (or no incoming-W2W anchor). Must check both and all other families for target 0.

categories.mechanism: Reverse edges and chains exist but chronological order, amount consistency or current return proportion fails.
categories.name: Refund / settlement / reciprocal-looking activity
categories.required_failed_family_condition: No full qualifying chronological simple path, or every such path fails an amount ratio. Presence of a topological path alone is not N3.

categories.mechanism: Returning-customer expansion, moderate acquisition, market-day demand, customer migration and low-period recovery.
categories.name: Busy / growing agents
categories.required_failed_family_condition: A1 new count<4, novelty<0.5, recent distinct<6 or growth<1.5; A3 hourly growth<3 or recent distinct<3. Later recovery is not a gate.

categories.mechanism: Repeat clientele with stable concentration; cash direction aligned with prior season or with weak count/value agreement.
categories.name: Concentrated customer / cash demand
categories.required_failed_family_condition: A2 share change<0.2 or top2 share<0.65; A4 abs skew change<0.4, abs count skew<0.5, abs value skew<0.6 or sign disagreement.

example_status: These are mathematical design examples, not generated rows, measured prevalence or fixed signatures. Eligible history and >=12 baseline services are assumed. Draw broad overlapping recipe parameters; do not copy exact example tuples across episodes.
joint_negative_rule: A named failed gate rules out only its family. A true target 0 case must have every family false under the common evaluator. Hard-origin rows satisfying any full predicate must be target 1; never delete, relabel or regenerate them to preserve a negative quota.
status: DESIGN_ONLY; implementation and population evidence pending
